financial_years.quote: challenging the Show Cause Notice dated 31st May, 2024 (hereinafter ‘SCN’) and the impugned order dated 8th August, 2024 (hereinafter ‘impugned order’) passed in respect of Financial Year 2019-20 by the office of Sales Tax Officer Class II/ AVATO, Delhi.

and the impugned order dated 8th August, 2024 (hereinafter ‘impugned order’) passed in respect of Financial Year 2019-20 by the office of Sales Tax Officer Class II/ AVATO, Delhi.

events.quote: The submission on behalf of the Petitioner is that the Petitioner had also applied for cancellation of the GST registration way back on 11th April, 2022.
On the facts of the present case, the SCN was issued to the Petitioner on 31st May, 2024.
A reminder notice is also stated to have been issued to the Petitioner on 27th June, 2024.
Ld. Counsel for the Petitioner submits that no reply to the SCN was filed by the Petitioner.
The impugned order was thereafter, passed on 8th August, 2024.

defects_argued.quote: Additionally, the petition also challenges the vires of Notification No. 9/2023-Central Tax dated 31st March, 2023, Notification No. 56/2023- Central Tax dated 28th December, 2023, Notification 9/2023-State Tax dated 31st March, 2023and Notification 56/2023-State Tax dated 11th July, 2024 (hereinafter ‘impugned notifications’).

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside.
